_note: Bismuth Prompt Studio -- what tools/setup_models.py can fetch. Every entry names its ORIGINAL host: llama.cpp from its own GitHub releases (MIT), the embedding model and the language models from their Hugging Face repositories. Nothing is mirrored, so nothing goes stale or out of licence. To offer your own build or fine-tune, add an entry under 'models' (or replace 'embed') with a direct download URL -- a Hugging Face 'resolve' link is the reliable kind -- or point the script at your own copy of this file with --manifest <url>.

llama_cpp._note: Windows x64 builds. 'pinned' is the build the studio was tested against; --latest asks GitHub for the newest. A CUDA build also needs its runtime zip.
